settings_machine_description: Whether {productName} is running and ready to capture, and where it shows up.
shortcuts_description: Set a shortcut for any command, in {productName} or everywhere.
shortcut_reach_focused: Works in {productName}, synced across your devices
shortcut_reach_hint: A bare key works in {productName}, a chord works everywhere.
undo_nothing_at_cursor: There is no dictation at your cursor to remove. Only text {productName} pasted at the cursor can be taken back.

settings_interface_language_description: The language {productName} speaks. Changing it reloads the app so every screen switches at once.
